_source: verified 2026-09-17 from the RF4S.exe IDB handlers; regenerate with gen_aibn_meta.py

0x00.effect: Clears mode bits 0x180, PC+=1, then loops: fetch opcode; if id<=8 stop and call MonsterScript_AdvanceToActionMarkerToken; else clear cond bit 0x200, call handler, then MonsterScript_StepCommandList(ctx,1) (returns 0 -> yield). Not used by any shipped AI_*.bin.

0x01.effect: ACTION-BEGIN marker. PC+=1 (END/wrap check); rule_counter(+91)++; flags&=~7 (per-action sub-state=0; Monster_AdvanceState never resets it, so every action in shipped files is preceded by 0x01); zero +48..+55, +72..+79, +80..+83; unless the actor tick is an attack/anim/grab tick: action_slot(+64)=-1, field_60(+96)=-1; if flags&0x4000 (section pass): if !(flags&0x8000) clear bit31, actor.control_flags&=~(0x20000|0x20|0x800000) and ~4 (unless char_id==225), zero scripted target (+188); flags|=0x8000. Returns 1.

0x02.effect: Same loop as 0x00 but steps with StepCommandList(ctx,0); on exit, if cond bit 0x200 set, zero actor vel_x/vel_y/vel_z. Not used by shipped files.

0x03.effect: PC+=1 (END/wrap check) and return 0 (end this tick). NOTE: the IDB comment says PC+=2; the code does ++pc. MonsterScript_AdvanceToNextStatement also stops scanning at a 0x80000003 token. Shipped files: one per file, right after 0x0A.

operands.label: label id
operands.meaning: label id matched against the operand of a 0x05 LabelMarker

0x04.effect: Linear scan of the whole token array from index 1 for (0x80000005, id); PC = that index + 1 (after the id). Not found -> Monster_OnScriptEnd. Returns 1.

operands.label: label id
operands.meaning: label id (0x05: goto target; 0x07: subroutine id)

0x05.effect: PC+=2 (skip id), END/wrap check, return 1. Shared handler for 0x05 and 0x07.

operands.label: subroutine id
operands.meaning: subroutine id matched against the operand of a 0x07 marker

0x06.effect: SP = flags bits 16-19. If SP>=10: PC+=2 and return 0 (call ignored). Else scan for (0x80000007,id): push return PC (=PC+2, after END/wrap check) to return_stack[SP] (+116), SP++, PC = marker index+1, return 1. Not found -> Monster_OnScriptEnd, return 0.

0x07.effect: Subroutine entry marker; same fall-through handler as 0x05. Every handler epilogue compares the token at the new PC with 0x80000007 and calls Monster_OnScriptEnd when it matches, so falling off the main body into the first subroutine acts as end-of-script (the chapter's END sentinel is this marker).

0x08.effect: If SP (flags bits 16-19) != 0: SP--, PC = return_stack[SP], slot zeroed. Returns 1. No-op when the stack is empty.

0x09.effect: Section label. Load-time (MonsterScript_SpawnTaskAndLoadScript): index stored in label_pc[n] (+136), n = flags bits 20-23, max 10. Runtime handler = PC+=1 fall-through. MonsterScript_RunnerTick runs each section from label_pc[i] every tick before the main body (flags|=0x4000, checkpoint +60 = main PC); a 0x01 executed during that pass sets 0x8000 and the main PC is not restored, so the section rule pre-empts the main body until the section reaches 0x0A.

0x0A.effect: If flags&0x8000 (a section rule fired): zero return_stack, SP=0, set flags bit31. Always: clear 0x8000, PC=0, +60 checkpoint=0, return 0 (yield). Bit31 stops RunnerTick from restoring the pre-section PC, so the main body restarts from token 0 next tick.

0x0B.effect: If actor tick is Actor_TickAttackAnimType1/2, Actor_TickAnimAndCustomCallback or Actor_TickGrabSlamAndThrow: PC = u16 at +60 (checkpoint written by RunnerTick before each section run), clear 0x8000, return 0. Else PC+=1, return 1.

0x0C.effect: IF-block. Clears mode bits 0x180, PC+=1, then loop: fetch opcode, clear 0x200, call handler, StepCommandList(ctx,0) until it returns 0. Condition chain: 0x94 = AND (false -> MonsterScript_SkipConditionalBlock sets else-pending 0x20000000 and jumps to the matching 0x0D/0x0E/0x0F at nesting depth 0), 0x93 = OR (true -> MonsterScript_FindNextActionOp jumps to the next opcode with id<0x5D). Returns 1; the action tokens that follow are executed by the outer dispatch loop.

0x0D.effect: ELSE. If else-pending (0x20000000): PC+=1 into the else body. Else (then-body ran): MonsterScript_AdvanceToBlockCloseAtSameLevel (+0x1C7450). Clears 0x20000000, returns 1.

0x0F.effect: ELSE-IF. If else-pending: PC+=1, clear 0x20000000 and mode bits, run its own condition chain like 0x0C; if the chain ends false, MonsterScript_AdvanceToBlockCloseOrElseAtSameLevel (+0x1C7530). If not else-pending: AdvanceToBlockCloseAtSameLevel. Returns 1.

0x10.effect: Loop-start marker. Load-time: loop_start_pc(+56)=index and initial PC=index. Runtime: PC+=1 fall-through.

0x11.effect: PC = loop_start_pc(+56); return 0 (yield). Load-time: index stored in loop_end_pc(+58).

0x12.effect: End of main body. If SP!=0: pop return_stack into PC (acts as Return). Else: zero return_stack, flags&=~0x000F8000 (SP and 0x8000), PC=0, block_state(+63)=0. Returns 0 (yield). Also called by every handler epilogue when the token at the new PC is 0x80000007.

operands.label: arrival distance to target
operands.meaning: arrival distance to target (+8) or to scripted tile (+188) if set

0x13.effect: Sub-state 0: walk_frame_counter=0, speed(+72)=max(|vel_x|,|vel_y|). Each tick: if Actor_HasReachedTargetAndNotBlocked -> PC+=n+1; else dist=Monster_DistanceToTarget(actor,target) (or DistanceToTileTarget when +188 set); if dist<=op0 or (op1 && ++counter==op1) -> Monster_AdvanceState(ctx,n+1); else step toward target.pos (facing*8 ahead when no target; scripted tile when set) with Monster_PathStepWithWaypointQueue, speed ramped by Monster_ComputeMaxStep/Monster_GetCurrentSpeed and halved once when +192 bit 0x4000 (recent collision) is set. Returns 0 every tick.

operands.label: stop when distance to target
operands.meaning: stop when distance to target (or scripted tile) >= this (0 = ignore)

0x14.effect: BACK-AWAY primitive. Sub-state 0: speed=max(|vel|); probe rotation step 0x2000 (45 deg) with random sign; facing=atan2(target-actor) (or scripted tile). Sub-state 1: up to 8 tries, probe cell = pos - sinCos(facing)*8 units (one cell AWAY from the target), accept if (tile & ~actor.init_flags & 0x9E)==0 else rotate facing by the step. Sub-state 2: if op1 && ++walk_frame_counter>=op1 -> PC+=n+1; elif op0 && dist>=op0 -> PC+=n+1; else Monster_TryStepWithCollision toward the probe cell (skipped when stats.field_20&0x30000==0x20000); when blocked/arrived: re-probe (sub-state 1) if op1 set or dist<op0, else Monster_AdvanceState. Shipped usage (Orc AI_m00: IfDistanceToTarget <= 44 -> TickAI 90 30) confirms the retreat reading.

operands.label: leg length
operands.meaning: leg length: target = pos + op0 * unit-direction

0x15.effect: Sub-state 0: Fisher-Yates shuffle of the 8 g_wanderDir*_Q12 unit vectors (MMIX RNG), pick first candidate cell with (attr&0x21)!=0 && (attr&0x9E)==0, store cell in +52/+54, speed=max(|vel|). Sub-state 1: Monster_TryStepWithCollision toward it until blocked/arrived (Monster_QueryTileBlockedOrReachedTarget). Sub-state 2: if field_58(+88)+1==op2 -> PC+=4, +88=0; else wait op1 frames, +88++, back to sub-state 0. Reads 3 operands; PC advance is a fixed +4.

operands.label: distance from the target to the warp
operands.meaning: distance from the target to the warp point

operands.label: angle
operands.meaning: angle added to target.facing_yaw for the warp point; 0xFFFF (65535) = random direction; 32768 = behind

0x16.effect: BLINK-TELEPORT near the target (+8), not a wander. State 0: actor.control_flags|=0x20, status_equip_flags|=0x10000000. State 1: 40 frames, toggling control bit 4 every 4 frames. State 2 -> 3: at frame 60 dest = target.pos + op0*sinCos(target.facing+op1); if op1==0xFFFF or the cell fails ((attr&0x21) && !(attr&0x9E)), try the 8 g_wanderDir directions in random rotation; then WRITES actor.world_x/y = dest, pos_z=0 (while waiting, actor.field_230[4]|=0x300 each frame). State 4: 40 frames, then clear control 0x20/4 and status 0x10000000, Monster_AdvanceState(ctx,3) (PC+=3).

0x17.effect: If no target: PC+=n+1. If in front of target (dot(actor-target, target.facing)>=0): candidates at target.facing +/-18204 (q16) * op0, walk to the farther one via Monster_PathStepWithWaypointQueue; else walk to target.pos + op0*sinCos(facing+0x7FFF) (behind) via Monster_TryStepWithCollision and Monster_AdvanceState on arrival. Done when Actor_HasReachedTargetAndNotBlocked or counter==op1 -> MonsterScript_AdvanceToActionMarkerToken and zero velocity. Unused in shipped files.

0x18.effect: Op13 variant: sets actor.control_flags|=0x800000 on entry and clears it on completion (PC+=n+1). Unused in shipped files.

operands.label: retreat distance past the target alo
operands.meaning: retreat distance past the target along target->actor direction

0x19.effect: Entry: control_flags|=0x20000, speed snapshot. Each tick: dest = target.pos + op0*sinCos(atan2(actor-target)); Monster_TryStepWithCollision; then writes atan2(target-actor) to *(u16*)(X+158) (aim yaw; base pointer lost in pseudocode). After op1 frames: clear 0x20000, PC+=n+1. Unused in shipped files.

operands.label: angle offset
operands.meaning: angle offset added to the bearing to the target (x181 = q16 degrees)

0x1A.effect: Each tick: bearing = atan2(target-actor) (scripted tile if +188 set) + 181*op0 -> +72; vel_x/vel_y = speed*sinCos(bearing) (speed ramped, +76). Ends when counter==op1 or Monster_QueryTileBlockedOrReachedTarget: PC+=n+1.

0x1B.effect: Entry: heading(+72) = atan2(target-actor) + (MMIX rand>>16) (one-shot random jitter over the full circle). Each tick sets vel from heading; ends at counter==op0 or tile blocked/arrived: PC+=2 (or +1 if no operand). Unused in shipped files.

0x1C.effect: Entry: heading(+72) = atan2(target-actor) +/- 0x3FFF, speed snapshot(+76), control_flags|=0x20000. Each tick: vel = speed*sinCos(heading); writes Math_GetFacingAngleFromAToB(actor,target) to *(u16*)(X+158). Ends at counter==op1 or Monster_QueryTileBlockedOrReachedTarget: PC+=n+1, clear 0x20000.

operands.label: duration frames
operands.meaning: duration frames; 0 = never ends by itself

0x1D.effect: Sub-state 0: speed(+72)=max(|vel|). Each tick: speed ramped by ComputeMaxStep/GetCurrentSpeed (halved once on +192&0x4000); vel_x += speed*sin(actor.facing_yaw), vel_y += speed*cos(...), each clamped to [-speed,+speed]. When op0 && ++counter==op0: Monster_AdvanceState(ctx, 2 or 1). Returns 0.

operands.label: angle
operands.meaning: angle added to the bearing toward the snapshotted target position (raw q16: 16384 = +90 deg, 49152 = -90 deg)

operands.label: frames of acceleration
operands.meaning: frames of acceleration; after that the actor coasts until velocity is zero or a tile blocks

operands.label: unused
operands.meaning: read but not used by the handler (always 0 in shipped files)

0x1E.effect: SIDESTEP relative to the target. Sub-state 0: control_flags|=0x20000; if no target PC+=n+1, return 1; snapshot target.x/y/z to +72/+76/+80. Each tick: while (counter<op1 || vel!=0) && !Monster_QueryTileBlockedOrReachedTarget: actor.facing_b = atan2(target-actor) (live target); if counter<op1: +84 += GetCurrentSpeed, clamped to +/-ComputeMaxStep; vel = +84 * sinCos(atan2(snapshot-actor) + op0); counter++. Else: PC+=n+1, clear 0x20000, return 1. Shipped files use only op0 in {16384, 49152} (left/right strafe) with op1 8..80.

operands.label: distance ahead of the player along p
operands.meaning: distance ahead of the player along player.facing_yaw

0x1F.effect: point = g_playerActor.pos + op0*sinCos(player.facing_yaw); attr = tile-attribute cell at point (work_buffer+664 grid). If (attr & 0x21) != 0 (same test Op15 uses for a walkable cell): zero actor vel; Action_TriggerAttacker(player, 0x26, box at actor pos, radius (field_B0+2048)/4096, z -8192); WRITE actor.world_x/y/pos_z = point, facing_yaw = facing_b = player.facing (attack_info.hit_dir_off adjusted); then three more Action_TriggerAttacker(player, 0x26, ...) at the new pos and at +/- field_B0-scaled offsets. Always PC+=2 (or +1), return 0. Purpose of trigger 0x26 not established. Every regular monster file uses it once with operand 24 in the trailer block after 0x0A.

operands.label: distance past the target
operands.meaning: distance past the target (+8) along the actor->target bearing

0x20.effect: As 0x1F but point = target.pos - op0*sinCos(atan2(target-actor)) and the Action_TriggerAttacker(target.task_back, 0x26, ...) calls target the leader/target task; no target -> PC+=1. PC+=2 (or +1), return 0.

operands.label: arrival distance to the combat targe
operands.meaning: arrival distance to the combat target (+16)

0x21.effect: As 0x13 but the subject is ctx+16 (combat target). No combat target -> PC+=n+1. On Actor_HasReachedTargetAndNotBlocked: PC+=n+1 and, if actor.status_equip_flags&0x200 (NPC), path_blocked(+94)=1. dist<=op0 or timeout -> Monster_AdvanceState(ctx,n+1). Else Monster_PathStepWithWaypointQueue toward combat target pos (+88).

operands.label: angle offset
operands.meaning: angle offset added to the bearing to the combat target (raw, not x181; register lost in pseudocode)

operands.label: turn-rate shift
operands.meaning: turn-rate shift: per-tick step = remaining delta >> op1 (min 1)

0x22.effect: No combat target (+16) -> PC+=n+1, return 0. Sub-state 0: control_flags|=0x20000, goal(+72) = Math_GetFacingAngleFromAToB(actor, combat target) + op0. Each tick: facing_yaw/facing_b step toward goal by delta>>op1 (shortest way); attack_info.hit_dir_off adjusted. When equal: Monster_AdvanceState(ctx,n+1), clear 0x20000, return 1.

operands.label: offset distance from the combat targ
operands.meaning: offset distance from the combat target toward the leader/target (+8)

0x23.effect: Needs +16 and +8. point = combat.pos + (op0<<12)*sinCos(atan2(target - combat)) (between the combat target and the leader). Actor_HasReachedTargetAndNotBlocked -> PC+=n+1; Monster_DistanceToTarget(actor,point) <= (threshold register lost in pseudocode) or timeout -> Monster_AdvanceState(ctx,n+1); else Monster_PathStepWithWaypointQueue(ctx, combat, point, speed). Missing either target -> PC+=n+1.

operands.label: x as Q12 fraction of map width
operands.meaning: x as Q12 fraction of map width (work_buffer[13] cells)

operands.label: y as Q12 fraction of map height
operands.meaning: y as Q12 fraction of map height (work_buffer[14] cells)

0x24.effect: dest = (op * (cells<<15)) >> 12 (world coords). Actor_HasReachedTargetAndNotBlocked -> PC+=n+1. Monster_DistanceToTileTarget(actor-dest) <= 0x8000 (one cell) -> zero vel, Monster_AdvanceState(ctx,n+1). Timeout -> AdvanceState. Else Monster_PathStepWithWaypointQueue(ctx, NULL, dest, speed); if it returns nonzero (arrived) zero vel + AdvanceState.

0x25.effect: If +16 is null or its stats.status_flags(+172)&0x8000 is clear: scan the 10 pointers at g_activeKillAggregateList+16; skip destroyed/dying tasks and self; require candidate stats.status_flags&0x8000; angular distance from actor.facing_yaw to atan2(cand-actor) must be <= ai_fov_width/2; pick the smallest Monster_DistanceToTarget below ai_sight_range^2; store in +16. With a target: Actor_HasReachedTargetAndNotBlocked -> PC+=1; distance > 0x30 -> Monster_PathStepWithWaypointQueue toward it; else Player_BeginMountTransitionAndInstallTickAndAnchor(actor, target) and Monster_AdvanceState(ctx,1) (MOUNTS the target). No target -> PC+=1. Returns 0.

operands.label: scripted action slot
operands.meaning: index into g_npcScriptedActionTable (+0x4D9EC0, 35 entries, no bounds check)

0x26.effect: block_state(+63)=3; r = g_npcScriptedActionTable[op0](actor) (handler receives the Actor_t, finds ctx through actor+296). r==0 -> return 0 (yield, re-invoked next tick with +63 still 3). r!=0 -> +63=0, PC+=2 (or +1), END/wrap check, return 0.

operands.label: angle offset in degrees
operands.meaning: angle offset in degrees (x181) added to the bearing to the target (+8)

operands.label: turn-rate shift
operands.meaning: turn-rate shift: per-tick step = remaining delta >> op1 (0 = snap in one tick, min step 1)

0x27.effect: Sub-state 0: control_flags|=0x20000; goal(+72) = atan2(target-actor) + 181*op0 (0 if no target). Each tick: facing_yaw/facing_b move toward goal by delta>>op1 along the shorter way (attack_info.hit_dir_off adjusted). When facing_yaw==goal: PC+=n+1, clear 0x20000, return 1; else return 0.

operands.label: duration frames
operands.meaning: duration frames (tracks the target for this long)

0x28.effect: Sub-state 0: counter=0, goal = atan2(target-actor)+181*op0. Each tick recomputes the goal from the live target (or actor.facing_b + offset when no target) and steps facing_yaw/facing_b by delta>>op1. When ++counter >= op2: PC+=n+1, clear control 0x20000, return 1.

operands.label: degrees
operands.meaning: degrees added to facing_yaw every tick (x181; negative = other way)

0x29.effect: Sub-state 0: counter=0, control_flags|=0x20000. Each tick: facing_yaw = facing_b = facing_yaw + 181*op0 (attack_info.hit_dir_off adjusted). When ++counter >= op1: PC+=n+1, clear 0x20000, return 1.

operands.label: total spread in degrees
operands.meaning: total spread in degrees; goal = facing + uniform[-op0/2, +op0/2]

0x2A.effect: Sub-state 0: control_flags|=0x20000; span=181*op0; goal(+72) = facing_yaw + span/2 - (MMIX rand * span >> 32). Each tick steps facing toward goal by delta>>op1 (same stepper as 0x27). When equal: PC+=n+1, clear 0x20000, return 1.

0x2B.effect: Sub-state 0: control_flags|=0x20000; goal(+72)=181*op0. Each tick steps facing_yaw/facing_b toward goal by delta>>op1. When equal: PC+=n+1, clear 0x20000, return 1.

operands.label: action id
operands.meaning: action id passed as BOTH anim_offset and skill_id to Actor_BeginAttackOrSkill(actor,id,id)

0x2C.effect: Sub-state 0: if action_slot(+64)!=id: Actor_BeginAttackOrSkill(actor,id,id); +96=+64=id; sub-state=1. Every tick: while actor tick is Actor_TickAttackAnimType1/2, Actor_TickAnimAndCustomCallback or Actor_TickGrabSlamAndThrow return 0 (wait). Then PC+=2 (or +1 without operand), +64=+96=-1, return 1.

operands.label: skill_id argument of Actor_BeginAtta
operands.meaning: skill_id argument of Actor_BeginAttackOrSkill; also stored in +64/+96

0x2D.effect: Sub-state 0: if action_slot(+64)!=op1: Actor_BeginAttackOrSkill(actor, op0, op1); +96=+64=op1; sub-state=1. Then, like 0x2C, returns 0 while the actor tick is an attack/anim/grab tick; afterwards PC+=n+1, +64=+96=-1, return 1. NOT fire-and-forget: it waits exactly like 0x2C; the difference is the separate anim_offset/skill_id operands.

operands.label: angle offset in degrees
operands.meaning: angle offset in degrees (x181) added to the bearing to the target

0x2E.effect: Sub-state 0 (if +64!=op0): facing_yaw=facing_b = Math_GetFacingAngleFromAToB(actor,target)+181*op1, or leader(+24).facing_yaw when no target; Actor_BeginAttackOrSkill(actor,op0,op0); +64=+96=op0. Waits while the actor tick is an attack/anim/grab tick; then PC+=n+1, +64=+96=-1. Returns 0 always.

operands.label: angle offset in degrees
operands.meaning: angle offset in degrees (x181) added to the bearing to the target

0x2F.effect: As 0x2E but Actor_BeginAttackOrSkill(actor, op0, op2) and the snap angle uses op1. (IDB comment order action,unused,angle is wrong: operand 1 is the angle, operand 2 the skill id.) Unused in shipped files.

operands.label: max spread in degrees
operands.meaning: max spread in degrees: snap angle = bearing + uniform[-op1,+op1]

0x30.effect: As 0x2E but the snap angle is Math_GetFacingAngleFromAToB(actor,target) + (rand*2*181*op1>>32) - 181*op1 (MMIX RNG); leader facing when no target. Waits for the attack tick; PC+=n+1; returns 0.

0x31.effect: As 0x30 but Actor_BeginAttackOrSkill(actor, op0, op2) with spread 181*op1. Unused in shipped files.

0x32.effect: Sub-state 0: if +64!=op0: Actor_BeginAttackOrSkill(actor,op0,op0), +64=+96=op0; sub-state=1; return 0. Sub-state 1: the wait-for-attack-tick check is skipped (action cut short, PC advances) when target(+8) exists AND Npc_IsBusyOrInaccessible(target) AND actor.attack_info.flags_140&8; otherwise waits while the actor tick is an attack/anim/grab tick. Then PC+=2 (or 1), +64=+96=-1, return 1.

0x33.effect: Dispatch slot 0x33 points at the CRT stub UserMathErrorFunction (returns 0 without touching the ctx). A script token 0x80000033 would therefore end the tick without advancing the PC (the handler returns 0 and the PC is never moved), i.e. the script would stall; no shipped file uses it.

operands.label: effect/skill anim id
operands.meaning: effect/skill anim id passed to Actor_BeginSkillEffectAnim(actor,id)

0x34.effect: Sub-state 0: Actor_BeginSkillEffectAnim(actor, op0) (+0x161970); +96=op0 (not +64); sub-state=1. Waits while the actor tick is an attack/anim/grab tick; then PC+=2 (or 1), +64=+96=-1. Returns 0 always. Shipped operands are spell/effect ids (108-114, 204-205, 47, 0, register r1).

0x35.effect: Sub-state 0->1. Each tick: if Monster_DistanceToTarget(actor,target(+8)) >= op0: PC+=2 (or 1) with END/wrap check. Returns 0 always (no null check on target). Unused in shipped files.

operands.label: held-item category
operands.meaning: held-item category: 1 random 239..285, 2 random 131/132/133, 3 item 115, 4 item 116, 5 item 117, 6 item 127 (128 if base_stats.level>30), other random 134..238

0x36.effect: Sub-state 0: pick item id by category (MMIX RNG), tier = 0/1/2 by base_stats.level (>25, >50), Item_PackSlotFields, Item_SpawnVisualTask(g_gameMainTask) and Npc_AttachHeldItem(actor, task work buffer). Then wait until actor.action_state(+460) != 18; PC+=2 (or 1). Returns 0.

0x37.effect: HELD-ITEM use/release. Sub-state 0: kind = HIWORD(stats->as_atk_archive_base) (= stats+178): 0 -> nothing; char_id==10 -> NpcAction_BeginItemUse; kind 115 with actor.field_B4&1 (116: &4, 117: &2) -> NpcAction_BeginItemUse; else find the first g_playerActor[0..2] with field_B4&1, snap-face it (Math_Atan2_Q12 or Actor_SetFacingSnap) and Actor_BeginReleaseHeldItemAnim(actor); other kinds -> Actor_BeginReleaseHeldItemAnim. Then wait until actor.action_state(+460) not in {20,21}; PC+=1. Returns 0.

0x38.effect: Sub-state 0: sub-state=1, then (same tick) PC+=1 and return 0. Two-tick pacing gap. Unused in shipped files.

0x39.effect: Sets/clears control_flags(+568) bit 0x800000; PC+=2 (or 1); return 1. The bit is also cleared by 0x01 during the section pass and by MonsterScript_ResetContextState.

0x3A.effect: control_flags bit 0x20000 = op0 bit 0; PC+=2 (or 1); return 0. Unused in shipped files (the turn/wait opcodes set and clear the same bit themselves).

operands.label: Q12 value
operands.meaning: Q12 value written as float (op0/4096) to actor.mcmodel+384

0x3B.effect: If actor.scene_node->type == 1: *(float*)(actor.mcmodel + 384) = op0 * (1/4096). PC+=2 (or 1); return 1. Shipped values 3276..12288 (0.8x..3.0x, mode 4096=1.0), consistent with a model scale factor; the consumer of mcmodel+384 was not verified.

0x3C.effect: actor.vel_x = op0*sin(facing_yaw)>>12, vel_y = op0*cos(facing_yaw)>>12 (g_sinCosTableQ12). PC+=2 (or 1); return 1.

0x3D.effect: As 0x3C with angle facing_yaw+0x4000 (90 deg). PC+=2 (or 1); return 1.

0x3E.effect: ctx.speed_scale_q12 (+66) = op0 (u16). PC+=2 (or 1); return 1. Reader: Monster_ComputeMaxStep (see fields.md).

operands.label: acceleration scale
operands.meaning: acceleration scale, Q12 (4096 = 1.0; reset to 4096 by MonsterScript_ResetContextState)

0x3F.effect: ctx.accel_scale_q12 (+68) = op0 (u16). PC+=2 (or 1); return 1. Reader: Monster_GetCurrentSpeed (see fields.md).

operands.label: x as Q12 fraction of map width
operands.meaning: x as Q12 fraction of map width

operands.label: y as Q12 fraction of map height
operands.meaning: y as Q12 fraction of map height

0x40.effect: +188 = (op0 * 8*work_buffer[13]) >> 12, +190 = (op1 * 8*work_buffer[14]) >> 12 (tile units = world>>12). While +188/+190 != 0, 0x13/0x14/0x18/0x1A/0x5D use the tile instead of the target actor. Cleared by 0x01 (section pass) and ResetContextState. PC+=n+1; return 1.

0x41.effect: Sub-state 0: counter(+48)=op0; unless ai_script_id in 199..204: x2 if actor.field_B4&0x10, x2 if &0x20, x4 if g_globalGameStateFlags&0x4000; control_flags|=0x20000. Countdown; at 0: PC+=2, clear 0x20000, return 0.

operands.label: present in files
operands.meaning: present in files (179, 108, 109) but never read by the handler

0x93.effect: OR connector between two conditions: when the condition before it is true the runner jumps straight to the next action opcode (MonsterScript_FindNextActionOp, id < 0x5D); when false the next condition is evaluated.
